meta.title: Leo Is Lost on the Hill

paragraphs: On Friday, Teacher Kim took her class on a trip to the hill. The bus ride was long, and the road had many turns. Leo felt sick, and his stomach hurt. At the hill, the children walked along a path to the lake. Leo walked slowly at the back, and nobody saw him. He sat down under a tree and closed his eyes. The sun was hot, and the hill was green and quiet.

At twelve o'clock, Teacher Kim counted the children. "Where is Leo?" she asked. Nobody knew the answer. "What is he wearing, Lily?" asked Teacher Kim. "He has a green cap and a white shirt," said Lily. "He has a yellow bag on his shoulder." "He felt sick on the bus," said May. "He might want to sit alone."

Teacher Kim looked at the map on her phone. "The lake is in the north," she said. "The picnic place is in the south." "Mia and Lily, do you mind going south along the path?" "I will go to the lake with May." "We don't mind," said Mia. "We can look for a green cap and a yellow bag."

The girls walked along the path and called his name. "Leo! Leo!" Nobody answered, and the path was quiet. Then a green cap appeared from behind a big tree. "Here I am," said Leo in a small voice. "My stomach does not hurt now." Lily gave him some water, and Mia called Teacher Kim on the phone. Leo ate a little rice from his bag and felt better. The two girls walked with him back to the picnic place. "Please tell me next time," said Teacher Kim.
text.summary: On a class trip to the hill, Leo feels sick and sits alone under a tree. Lily and Mia find him from the green cap that Lily described.
